title: Aerolux 300 Air Purifier
key_sentences: The Aerolux 300 cleans the air of rooms up to 45 square metres with a quiet, energy-efficient fan.
It is designed for bedrooms, offices and classrooms where clean air matters every day.
The H13 filter captures 99.97 percent of particles down to 0.3 micrometres.
In night mode the purifier runs at only 24 decibels.
The sensor adjusts the fan speed automatically to the measured air quality.
The Aerolux 300 is covered by a limited warranty of three years from the date of purchase.
The warranty does not cover filters, which are consumable parts.

tables.caption: Dimensions of the product and its packaging

list_items.text: Place the purifier on a flat surface, at least 30 centimetres from walls and furniture.
Remove all packaging and the plastic bag from the filter.
Connect the power cable and press the power button.
Pair the device with the mobile app by scanning the code on the back panel.
